milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate toward the stone brick building east of spawn and look at the polished diorite stairs inside. The target [8, 0, 1] is the centroid of the 4-stair cluster placed at (8,0,0), (8,0,1), (8,0,2), and (9,0,1). max_distance=16 allows triggering from the building entrance or inside while facing the stairs. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking toward the stairs, not just nearby. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target' by checking both proximity and facing direction.
